text: अपनी किताब में पेज 18 से 20 तक ‘Anita Feeds Appu’ पढ़ो। फिर किताब के सवालों के जवाब दो। हर जवाब के बाद देखो कि परीक्षा में पूरा जवाब कैसे लिखना है।
Apni kitaab mein page 18 se 20 tak ‘Anita Feeds Appu’ padho. Phir kitaab ke sawaalon ke jawab do. Har jawab ke baad dekho ki pariksha mein poora jawab kaise likhna hai.

steps.question: Why is Anita very excited today?
questionMeaning: आज अनीता बहुत उत्साहित क्यों है?
Aaj Anita bahut utsaahit kyon hai?
options: Because Appu, the elephant, is at her door.
Because it is her birthday today.
Because her father bought her a new toy.
steps.answer: Because Appu, the elephant, is at her door.
steps.modelAnswer: Anita is very excited today because she sees Appu, the elephant, at her door.
modelMeaning: अनीता आज बहुत उत्साहित है क्योंकि वह अप्पू हाथी को अपने दरवाज़े पर देखती है।
Anita aaj bahut utsaahit hai kyonki woh Appu haathi ko apne darwaaze par dekhti hai.

steps.question: Where has she seen the elephants before?
questionMeaning: उसने पहले हाथी कहाँ देखे हैं?
Usne pehle haathi kahan dekhe hain?
options: In the movies and in cartoon shows on T.V.
In the zoo near her school.
steps.answer: In the movies and in cartoon shows on T.V.
steps.modelAnswer: She has seen elephants in the movies and in cartoon shows on T.V.
modelMeaning: उसने हाथी फ़िल्मों में और टीवी पर कार्टून शो में देखे हैं।
Usne haathi filmon mein aur TV par cartoon show mein dekhe hain.

steps.question: How did Appu drink a bucketful of water?
questionMeaning: अप्पू ने बाल्टी भर पानी कैसे पिया?
Appu ne baalti bhar paani kaise piya?
options: He sucked it all up from the bucket at one go.
He drank it slowly with a glass.
He spilled it on the ground.
steps.answer: He sucked it all up from the bucket at one go.
steps.modelAnswer: Appu sucked up all the water from the bucket with his trunk, at one go.
modelMeaning: अप्पू ने अपनी सूँड से बाल्टी का सारा पानी एक ही बार में खींच लिया।
Appu ne apni soond se baalti ka saara paani ek hi baar mein kheench liya.

steps.question: What did Appu do with his trunk?
questionMeaning: अप्पू ने अपनी सूँड से क्या किया?
Appu ne apni soond se kya kiya?
options: He took bananas in his trunk and put them into his mouth.
He picked up Anita and put her on his back.
steps.answer: He took bananas in his trunk and put them into his mouth.
steps.modelAnswer: Appu took the bananas in his trunk and put them into his mouth. He used his trunk like a hand.
modelMeaning: अप्पू ने सूँड से केले पकड़े और मुँह में डाले। उसने अपनी सूँड का इस्तेमाल हाथ की तरह किया।
Appu ne soond se kele pakde aur munh mein daale. Usne apni soond ka istemaal haath ki tarah kiya.

steps.question: How did the Mahout help the children ride Appu?
questionMeaning: महावत ने बच्चों को अप्पू की सवारी करने में कैसे मदद की?
Mahaavat ne bachchon ko Appu ki sawaari karne mein kaise madad ki?
options: He helped them climb on to Appu's back and sit in the howdah.
He gave them a ladder and went away.
He told them to hold Appu's tail.
steps.answer: He helped them climb on to Appu's back and sit in the howdah.
steps.modelAnswer: The Mahout helped the children climb on to the elephant's back and sit in the howdah.
modelMeaning: महावत ने बच्चों को हाथी की पीठ पर चढ़ने और हौदे में बैठने में मदद की।
Mahaavat ne bachchon ko haathi ki peeth par chadhne aur haude mein baithne mein madad ki.

turns.tinku: Have you ever had an elephant ride? Did you like it?
meaning: क्या तुमने कभी हाथी की सवारी की है? क्या तुम्हें अच्छा लगा?
Kya tumne kabhi haathi ki sawaari ki hai? Kya tumhe achha laga?

replies.say: Yes, I have. I liked it very much.
meaning: हाँ, की है। मुझे बहुत अच्छा लगा।
Haan, ki hai. Mujhe bahut achha laga.

replies.say: No, I have not. But I would like to have one.
meaning: नहीं, नहीं की। पर मैं करना चाहूँगा/चाहूँगी।

turns.tinku: Wow! You are lucky. Elephants are very big!
meaning: वाह! तुम किस्मत वाले हो। हाथी बहुत बड़े होते हैं!
Waah! Tum kismat waale ho. Haathi bahut bade hote hain!
हाँ, वे बहुत बड़े होते हैं।
Haan, woh bahut bade hote hain.

turns.tinku: Maybe one day you will ride an elephant like Anita!
meaning: शायद एक दिन तुम भी अनीता की तरह हाथी की सवारी करोगे!
Shaayad ek din tum bhi Anita ki tarah haathi ki sawaari karoge!
मुझे भी यही उम्मीद है!
Mujhe bhi yahi ummeed hai!

title: ग्रामर: bread, soap जैसे शब्द
Grammar: bread, soap jaise shabd
Grammar in Use: bread, soap, paper

text: कुछ चीज़ें हम गिनते नहीं, जैसे bread, chalk, furniture, information, knowledge, luggage, paper, soap। इनके साथ ‘s’ नहीं लगता। ‘two breads’ गलत है।
Kuch cheezein hum ginte nahi, jaise bread, chalk, furniture, information, knowledge, luggage, paper, soap. Inke saath ‘s’ nahi lagta. ‘two breads’ galat hai.
Some things we don't count, like bread, chalk, furniture, information, knowledge, luggage, paper and soap. They don't take ‘s’. ‘Two breads’ is wrong.
गिनना हो तो टुकड़े का शब्द लगाओ: a slice of bread (ब्रेड का एक टुकड़ा), a cake of soap (साबुन की एक टिकिया), a sheet of paper (कागज़ का एक पन्ना), a piece of chalk (चॉक का एक टुकड़ा)।
Ginna ho to tukde ka shabd lagao: a slice of bread (bread ka ek tukda), a cake of soap (saabun ki ek tikiya), a sheet of paper (kaagaz ka ek panna), a piece of chalk (chalk ka ek tukda).
To count them, add a word for the piece: a slice of bread, a cake of soap, a sheet of paper, a piece of chalk.
किताब के उदाहरण: Please give me a slice of bread. Wash your hands well before and after meals with a cake of soap.
Kitaab ke udaharan: Please give me a slice of bread. Wash your hands well before and after meals with a cake of soap.
